step timing excludes checkpoint I/O and validation

Combined FP8 + Muon correctness only; no interaction, convergence or optimizer-superiority claim.
Bounded pilot-blocks-v1 ingestion only; the source snapshot must be separately verified against reviewed T0016 pins; test data is integrity-checked only.
FP8 weight reuse is per-update only; no persistent cache or second-order claim.
Checkpoint interval reduces durable write frequency; interruption can lose up to interval-1 updates since the prior checkpoint under the trusted single-writer assumption.
